name: Buying event tickets on the website
body:
What you are doing

Event tickets are sold like other products in the online shop. You add tickets to your basket, go through checkout, and pay (or complete a free order) like a normal purchase.

Finding the right ticket

Open the event or ticket page from the website navigation or a link you were given. The product page should show which event the ticket is for, and when it takes place. Choose the quantity you need and add it to your basket.

Checkout

Proceed to checkout and enter billing details as usual. You do not have to complete every attendee name during checkout; this site may collect attendee information after payment instead.

Payment

Pay with the offered payment methods. When payment succeeds, the system may take you to a separate step to enter who will actually attend, or send you a link to do that later.

name: Completing attendee details after you pay
body:
Why this step exists

Each ticket must be tied to a person (or seat) for the event. After your order is paid, you may be redirected to a page that asks for each attendee’s details, or you may receive an email with a link to complete them.

Using the link

The completion page uses a private link tied to your order. Keep it safe: anyone with the link can update those attendee details until your organisation’s rules say otherwise.

Filling the form

For each ticket, answer the questions the organisers configured (name, email, phone, company, custom questions). If the event uses structured questions, the answers are saved so the organisers can see them.

Editing later

If you already submitted details, you may be able to change them from the same link or from your account area under registrations, depending on how close the event is.

name: Pending registrations in your account
body:
Where to look

Sign in and open your account area. If there is a section for pending event registrations or similar wording, open it. The web address may contain /my/pending-registrations.

What “pending” means here

You have an order for event tickets that is paid, but attendee details for those tickets are not finished yet. Complete the details so your registrations can be finalised.

What to do

Follow the link from that page to the attendee form for your order. Submit the form once each attendee is filled in.

name: Your event registrations list
body:
Where it is

Sign in to the website and open the area that lists your event registrations. The address often contains /my/registrations.

What you see

You should see registrations linked to orders for your company account (including colleagues under the same organisation, depending on how your contact records are set up).

Updating details

When the organisers allow changes, you may see an edit or update link next to a registration. There is often a cut-off a few days before the event starts; after that, changes may be disabled to keep the attendee list stable.

name: Free tickets and confirmation
body:
Free orders

If the total amount is zero, the shop may still create an order and confirm it without a payment step. You may then be sent to attendee details or confirmation in the same way as for paid tickets.

Confirmation

After attendee details are complete when required, you should reach an order confirmation page. Keep any confirmation email for your records.
